newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: No word yet on Philips strategy review.
newsitem.headline: No word yet on Philips strategy review.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Thursday it would not go public with the results of a strategic business review until early next year.
Chief financial officer Jan Hammen said Philips' business units and product divisions had recently submitted five-year strategic plans which senior management was now studying.
The subsequent process of analysis and discussion was likely to take several months, Hammen told Reuters Financial TV.
"I would think that some time early next year or maybe a little bit later we will be in a position to really decide strategically what it is that we want to do," he said.

New chairman Cor Boonstra has stressed that the enhancement of profitability is his first priority and that the strategic reshaping of Philips' business portfolio -- which runs from toasters to X-ray machines -- will follow later.
